project.title: Hong Kong Through Film — Film Still Audit V1

grade_definitions.A: An exact scene still is paired with a source page that explicitly identifies the target location.
grade_definitions.B: A film still exists and the filming location is supported, but the candidate frame has not yet been matched to the target place.
grade_definitions.C: No reliable exact online frame is ready for use; capture from an authorised viewing copy is required after the film–location relationship is verified.

project.rights_policy: These are research candidates, not cleared website assets. Public availability and attribution do not themselves grant reuse permission. Do not hotlink. Before publication, confirm the course's quotation/fair-dealing policy or obtain permission, use only the minimum image needed for critical commentary, and retain both film-rights and source-page credits.
project.default_usage_note: Research candidate only. Rights remain with the credited or otherwise unidentified rights holder; verify permission or the applicable classroom exception before publishing.
